backgrounds.prompt: Wide street-level view of an empty Israeli city intersection at night in the rain. Background: a row of four- and five-story beige Jerusalem-stone apartment blocks with small balconies, solar water heaters and antennas on the flat roofs, many warmly lit windows. Center: a small neighborhood grocery store with a green and white striped awning and fruit crates, closed shutters of a barbershop next to it. Left: a red octagonal stop sign on a pole and a small tree. Two tall street lamps with warm orange light. Lower third: wide empty wet asphalt road with white dashed lane markings and a zebra crosswalk on the left, puddles reflecting the lights. Sidewalk with curb across the middle of the frame. No people, no cars, no vehicles, no text, no letters, no logos. Moody blue night palette with warm window light, rain streaks.

Interior of an old Israeli apartment building stairwell landing at night, straight-on eye-level wide view of the back wall. Left quarter: concrete stairs going up with a dark metal railing. Back wall, left of center: grey metal mailboxes with a cork notice board below. Back wall, center and right: TWO identical closed brown wooden apartment doors side by side, evenly spaced, each with a small blank plate above it and a doormat in front; warm golden light leaking from under the right door. Ceiling lamp. Worn beige painted walls, speckled grey terrazzo floor in the bottom third. No people, no text, no letters, no numbers.

Shared courtyard between two Israeli apartment blocks on a bright sunny morning, blue sky, soft morning sunlight and shadows. Laundry lines with colorful clothes strung between balconies. Left: a ficus tree in a raised stone planter. Center-left: three green municipal trash bins. Center: a wooden bench. Right: a small corrugated grey metal storage shed with a closed door and a padlock, two bicycles leaning next to it. A courtyard lamp post. Stone paving floor in the bottom third. No people, no text, no letters.
